name: Oregon

items.label: Federal tax subtraction
items.note: Federal income tax paid is deductible up to $8,750, phasing out from $125,000 ($250,000 married).

items.label: Oregon income tax
items.note: Less the $256 exemption credit each, for incomes up to $100,000 ($200,000 married).

items.label: Paid Leave Oregon
items.note: 60% of the 1% contribution, on wages up to the Social Security wage base.

notModelled: Portland-area taxes: Metro Supportive Housing Services (1% over $125,000) and Multnomah County Preschool for All (1.5–3% over $125,000)
provisional: Standard deduction ($2,835 / $5,670) and exemption credit ($256) are the 2025 amounts
